title: Repeat three L-series upstream defects and the SQL grammar control
description: Rebuild the three development modules at frozen commits and compare the identical public callers on releases and development branches. Independently compare the JSqlParser grammar with a disposable PostgreSQL 16 server.
expected: The eighteen release and development histories reproduce their recorded returns. PostgreSQL rejects the TYPE/USING CASCADE tail with SQLSTATE 42601 and stores 103 after the query without the tail.
